        <meta property="og:description" content="Paul Bunyan Rifle &amp; Sportsman&#039;s Club&#039;s monthly USPSA  match.
*Monthly matches are held the second Sunday of each month and are noted on the Paul Bunyan Sportsman&#039;s &amp; Rifle Club website calendar, unless otherwise indicated for special events that may include additional days/nights. Each month&#039;s match will open for registration two weeks prior. 
*Approval of registrants are done on a first come first serve basis as time restriction allows for the match management team. We appreciate your patience as there may be times when approvals and/or correspondence can be several days.

**PLEASE READ ALL INFO BELOW**
8:00am-Gates open
9:45am-All shooters must be at designated stages
10:00am-Match starts
This will be a 6-8 stage match.
-Volunteers for set up crew that assist with set up on Friday and/or Saturday before the match and contribute a minimum of 4 hours will get their match fee refunded via Stripe...
-Selected RO/CRO&#039;s will get their match fee reduced by $10.00, which will be refunded via Stripe following completion of the match. By electing to RO, you will be expected to stay assigned to the squad you select unless that squad already has the designated number of RO&#039;s needed, in which you may be assigned to a different squad. We do our best to allow competitors to be grouped with those they wish to shoot with, but must be able to maintain a good and safe match flow.
All registration will be online only through Practiscore and will require payment to squad 
Refunds, minus Stripe fees, will be processed upon match completion for anyone who withdraws prior to close of registration at 9:00am on day of match. No refunds will be given for No Shows.
Anyone new to USPSA will need a USPSA safety check prior to day of match and will need to be arranged with one of the NW Section approved certified USPSA  Range Officers. Arrangements can be made with our club&#039;s Safety Officer. Dave Farrow by emailing him at dnfarrow@msn.com and can be scheduled most Tuesdays or Fridays as well as during match set up days.  PLEASE DO NOT REGISTER UNTIL THIS HAS BEEN COMPLETED AND PROOF CAN BE VERIFIED.
NO SAFETY CHECKS ON DAY OF MATCH!"/>

    $(document).ready(function() {
        $(".themeColor").on('change', function() {
            if ($("option:selected", this).index() != 0) {
                window.location = '/user/setcolor/' + $("option:selected", this).text();
            }
        });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        var lazyImages = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("img.lazy"));

        if ("IntersectionObserver"in window) {
            var lazyImageObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries, observer) {
                entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        var lazyImage = entry.target;
                        lazyImage.src = lazyImage.dataset.src;
                        lazyImage.srcset = lazyImage.dataset.srcset;
                        lazyImage.classList.remove("lazy");
                        lazyImageObserver.unobserve(lazyImage);
                    }
                });
            }
            );

            lazyImages.forEach(function(lazyImage) {
                lazyImageObserver.observe(lazyImage);
            });
        } else {
            // Possibly fall back to a more compatible method here
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
                var lazyImages = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("img.lazy"));
                var active = false;

                const lazyLoad = function() {
                    if (active === false) {
                        active = true;

                        setTimeout(function() {
                            lazyImages.forEach(function(lazyImage) {
                                if ((lazyImage.getBoundingClientRect().top <= window.innerHeight && lazyImage.getBoundingClientRect().bottom >= 0) && getComputedStyle(lazyImage).display !== "none") {
                                    lazyImage.src = lazyImage.dataset.src;
                                    lazyImage.srcset = lazyImage.dataset.srcset;
                                    lazyImage.classList.remove("lazy");

                                    lazyImages = lazyImages.filter(function(image) {
                                        return image !== lazyImage;
                                    });

                                    if (lazyImages.length === 0) {
                                        document.removeEventListener("scroll", lazyLoad);
                                        window.removeEventListener("resize", lazyLoad);
                                        window.removeEventListener("orientationchange", lazyLoad);
                                    }
                                }
                            });

                            active = false;
                        }, 200);
                    }
                };

                document.addEventListener("scroll", lazyLoad);
                window.addEventListener("resize", lazyLoad);
                window.addEventListener("orientationchange", lazyLoad);
            });
        }
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function() {
        var pageTextStyle = 'Normal';
        try {
            function setStyle(pageTextStyle) {
                $('.pageTextStyle').removeClass('active');
                if (pageTextStyle === "Compact") {
                    $('body').css('font-size', 12);
                    localStorage.setItem('pageTextStyle', 'Compact');
                } else if (pageTextStyle === "Comfortable") {
                    $('body').css('font-size', 16);
                    localStorage.setItem('pageTextStyle', 'Comfortable');
                } else {
                    $('body').css('font-size', 14);
                    localStorage.setItem('pageTextStyle', 'Normal');
                }
                $('#pageTextStyle' + pageTextStyle).addClass('active');
            }

            pageTextStyle = localStorage.getItem('pageTextStyle');
        } catch (error) {
            pageTextStyle = 'Normal';
        }

        if (pageTextStyle) {
            setStyle(pageTextStyle);
        }
        $('.pageTextStyle').click(function() {
            var style = $(this).attr('pageTextStyle');
            setStyle(style);
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    try {
        var historyByStageIndex = [];
        var stageUuidToIndex = [];
        var editCountsByShooterId = [];
        var ranCounts = false;

        function createEditHistoryString(stageHistories, editHistoryString) {
            if (stageHistories && stageHistories['shooters'].length > 0) {
                editHistoryString += "<div class='col-xs-12 panel'><div class='col-xs-12'><h3>" + stageHistories['stageName'] + "</h3></div>";
                var editShooter = stageHistories['shooters'];
                $.each(editShooter, function(shooterIndex, editsForShooter) {
                    if (individualShooter == 0 || individualShooter == editsForShooter['shooterId']) {
                        editHistoryString += "<div class='col-xs-12'><h4>" + editsForShooter['name'] + " (" + editsForShooter['diffs'].length + ")</h4>";
                        $.each(editsForShooter['diffs'], function(editIndex, edits) {
                            // N - indicates a newly added property/element
                            // D - indicates a property/element was deleted
                            // E - indicates a property/element was edited
                            // A - indicates a change occurred within an array
                            if (editIndex > 0) {
                                editHistoryString += "<div class='col-xs-12 bottom10'></div>";
                            }
                            var editTime = "";
                            var editsString = "";
                            $.each(edits, function(eIndex, edit) {
                                if (edit['kind'] == "N") {
                                    if (edit['rhs'] != "") {
                                        if (typeof edit['rhs'] === 'object' && typeof edit['rhs'][0] === 'object') {
                                            $.each(edit['rhs'], function(metaIndex, meta) {
                                                if (meta.hasOwnProperty('k') && meta.hasOwnProperty('v') && meta.hasOwnProperty('t')) {
                                                    if (meta.k == "from") {
                                                        editsString += "<div class='col-xs-12'>Added Reason for Edit " + meta.v + "</div>";
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            });
                                        } else {
                                            editsString += "<div class='col-xs-12'>Added " + edit['path'] + ": " + edit['rhs'] + "</div>";
                                        }
                                    }
                                } else if (edit['kind'] == "D") {
                                    if (typeof edit['lhs'] === 'object') {
                                        $.each(edit['lhs'], function(metaIndex, meta) {
                                            if (meta.hasOwnProperty('k') && meta.hasOwnProperty('v') && meta.hasOwnProperty('t')) {
                                                if (meta.k == "from") {
                                                    editsString += "<div class='col-xs-12'>Removed Reason for Edit " + meta.v + "</div>";
                                                }
                                            }
                                        });
                                    } else {
                                        editsString += "<div class='col-xs-12'>Removed " + edit['path'] + ": " + edit['lhs'] + "</div>";
                                    }
                                } else if (edit['kind'] == "E") {
                                    if (edit['path'].includes("ts")) {
                                        editsString += "<div class='col-xs-12'><div class='row'>";
                                        var previousA = numAlphas(edit['lhs']);
                                        var previousB = numBravos(edit['lhs']);
                                        var previousC = numCharlies(edit['lhs']);
                                        var previousD = numDeltas(edit['lhs']);
                                        var previousNS = numNS(edit['lhs']);
                                        var previousM = numM(edit['lhs']);
                                        var previousNPM = numNPM(edit['lhs']);

                                        var a = numAlphas(edit['rhs']);
                                        var b = numBravos(edit['rhs']);
                                        var c = numCharlies(edit['rhs']);
                                        var d = numDeltas(edit['rhs']);
                                        var ns = numNS(edit['rhs']);
                                        var m = numM(edit['rhs']);
                                        var npm = numNPM(edit['rhs']);

                                        editsString += "<div class='col-xs-8 col-lg-6'><table class='table table-condensed'><thead><tr>" + "<th></th><th>A</th><th>B</th><th>C</th><th>D" + "</th><th>NS</th><th>M</th><th>NPM</th></tr></thead>";

                                        editsString += "<tbody>";

                                        editsString += "<tr><td>Previous</td><td>" + previousA + "</td><td>" + previousB + "</td><td>" + previousC + "</td><td>" + previousD + "</td><td>" + previousNS + "</td>" + "<td>" + previousM + "</td><td>" + previousNPM + "</td></tr>";

                                        editsString += "<tr><td>Current</td><td>" + a + "</td><td>" + b + "</td><td>" + c + "</td><td>" + d + "</td><td>" + ns + "</td><td>" + m + "</td><td>" + npm + "</td></tr>";

                                        editsString += "</tbody></table></div></div></div>";

                                    } else if (edit['path'].includes('mod')) {
                                        editTime += "<div class='col-xs-12 text-muted'>" + edit['lhs'] + " - " + edit['rhs'] + "</div>" + "<div class='col-xs-12'>Edited " + moment(edit['lhs']).from(moment(edit['rhs']), true) + " after.</div>";
                                    } else {
                                        editsString += "<div class='col-xs-12'>Edited " + edit['path'] + " was: " + edit['lhs'] + " now: " + edit['rhs'] + "</div>";
                                    }
                                } else if (edit['kind'] == "A") {
                                    editsString += "<div class='col-xs-12'>" + "ARRAY" + "</div>";
                                }
                            });
                            editHistoryString += editTime + editsString;
                            editHistoryString += "<div class='col-xs-12'>Edited By " + edits['device'] + "</div>";
                        });
                        editHistoryString += "</div>";
                    }
                });
                editHistoryString += "</div>";
            }
            return editHistoryString;
        }

        function parseHistory() {
            stageUuidToIndex[matchId] = 0;
            $.each(levels, function(index, stage) {
                stageUuidToIndex[stage['stageUuid']] = index;
            });
            if (scores.hasOwnProperty('match_scores_history')) {
                var stagesByUuid = [];
                $.each(notDeletedStages, function(k, v) {
                    stagesByUuid[v['stage_uuid']] = v;
                });

                var scoreHistory = scores['match_scores_history'];
                $.each(scoreHistory, function(k, edits) {
                    var history = [];
                    if (stagesByUuid.hasOwnProperty(k)) {
                        history['stageName'] = stagesByUuid[k]['stage_name'];
                        history['shooters'] = [];
                        $.each(edits, function(editShooterId, editsForShooter) {
                            let shooter = shootersById[editShooterId]
                            if (!shooter && shootersById[shootersUuidToId[editShooterId]]) {
                                shooter = shootersById[shootersUuidToId[editShooterId]]
                            }
                            var previousScore = shooter["stageScores"][k];
                            var diffsForShooter = [];
                            $.each(editsForShooter, function(index, edit) {
                                var differences = DeepDiff.diff(edit, previousScore);
                                if (differences) {
                                    differences['device'] = edit['dname'];
                                    previousScore = edit;
                                    diffsForShooter.push(differences);
                                }
                            });
                            var name = findShooterNameById(editShooterId);
                            history['shooters'].push({
                                "diffs": diffsForShooter,
                                "name": name,
                                "shooterId": editShooterId
                            });

                            if (!ranCounts) {
                                if (editShooterId in editCountsByShooterId) {
                                    if (k in editCountsByShooterId[editShooterId]) {
                                        editCountsByShooterId[editShooterId][stageUuidToIndex[k]] += editsForShooter.length;
                                    } else {
                                        editCountsByShooterId[editShooterId][stageUuidToIndex[k]] = editsForShooter.length;
                                    }

                                    editCountsByShooterId[editShooterId][0] += editsForShooter.length;

                                } else {
                                    editCountsByShooterId[editShooterId] = [];
                                    editCountsByShooterId[editShooterId][stageUuidToIndex[k]] = editsForShooter.length;

                                    editCountsByShooterId[editShooterId][0] = editsForShooter.length;

                                }
                            }
                        });

                        historyByStageIndex[stagesByUuid[k]['stage_number']] = history;
                    }
                });

                if (historyByStageIndex.length > 0) {
                    var editHistoryString = "";

                    if (individualShooter != 0 || matchStageIndex == 0) {
                        $.each(historyByStageIndex, function(stageIndex, stageHistories) {
                            editHistoryString = createEditHistoryString(stageHistories, editHistoryString);
                        });
                    } else {
                        editHistoryString = createEditHistoryString(historyByStageIndex[matchStageIndex], editHistoryString);
                    }

                    $('#editHistory').html(editHistoryString);
                }
            }
            ranCounts = true;
        }
    } catch ($e) {
        window.bugsnagClient.notify($e);
    }
</script>

    function onError(event) {
        if (typeof alreadyDeleted == 'undefined') {
            var videoId = event.target.getIframe().id;
            var id = '';
            if (videoId.indexOf('videoIframeAll_') !== -1) {
                id = videoId.replace('videoIframeAll_', '');
            } else {
                id = videoId.replace('videoIframe_', '');
            }
            $.post('/videos/' + id + '/error/' + event.data)
        }
    }

    function videoIframeLoaded(video) {
        if (youtubeReady) {
            if (video['src'].indexOf('youtube.com') !== -1) {
                new YT.Player(video.id,{
                    events: {
                        'onError': onError
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }

        xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept', '*');

    function allFilesLoaded() {
        if (resultsLoaded && matchDefLoaded && matchScoresLoaded) {
            $("#spinner").hide();
            findNotDeletedStages();
            setMatchShootersByUuid();
            addStageScoresToShooters();
            getLevelStructure();
            parseHistory();
            getUrlParameters();
            createDropdownOptions();
            calculateRaw();
            calculateTargets();
            updateTable();
            setResultChangeEvents();
            setHorizontalScrollIndicator("#mainResultsTable", "#mainResultsDiv");
            if (individualShooter != 0) {
                displayIndividualShooter(individualShooter);
            } else {
                getVideos();
            }
        }
    }

    function setMatchShootersByUuid() {
        var matchShooters = matchDef["match_shooters"];
        $.each(matchShooters, function(index, shooter) {
            shootersById[shooter["sh_uid"]] = shooter;
            shootersById[shooter["sh_uid"]]["stageScores"] = [];
            shootersById[shooter["sh_uid"]]["matchScores"] = [];
            shootersUuidToId[shooter["sh_uuid"]] = shooter["sh_uid"];
        });
    }

    function addStageScoresToShooters() {
        var stages = scores['match_scores'];
        $.each(stages, function(index, stage) {
            $.each(stage["stage_stagescores"], function(index2, stageScore) {
                if ($.inArray(stage['stage_uuid'], notDeletedStageIds) != -1) {
                    var id = stageScore['shtr'];

                    if (id in shootersById) {
                        shootersById[id]["stageScores"][stage["stage_uuid"]] = stageScore;
                    }
                }
            })
        })
    }

    function findNotDeletedStages() {
        var stages = matchDef["match_stages"];
        $.each(stages, function(index, stage) {
            if (!stage["stage_deleted"]) {
                notDeletedStageIds.push(stage['stage_uuid']);
                notDeletedStages.push(stage);
            }
        })
    }

    function getLevelStructure() {
        levels = {};
        $.each(results, function(index, levelObj) {
            $.each(levelObj, function(levelName, divisionObj) {
                if (levelName != "stageUUID")
                    levels[index] = {
                        "name": levelName,
                        "stageUuid": levelObj["stageUUID"]
                    };
            })
        })

        divisions = {};
        $.each(results, function(index, result) {
            var matchDivisionLevel;
            for (var key in result) {
                if (key != "stageUUID") {
                    matchDivisionLevel = result[key];
                }
            }
            $.each(matchDivisionLevel, function(index2, divisionObj) {
                if (!divisions[index]) {
                    divisions[index] = {};
                }
                divisions[index][index2] = getFirstKey(divisionObj);
                //reversedDivisions[getFirstKey(divisionObj)] = index;
            })
        })
    }

    function getFirstKey(data) {
        var firstKey;
        $.each(data, function(key, val) {
            firstKey = key;
            return false;
        });
        return firstKey;
    }

    function getKeysFromStage(data) {
        var keys = {};
        $.each(data, function(key, val) {
            if (key == "stageUUID") {
                keys["stageId"] = val;
            } else {
                keys["stageName"] = key;
            }
        });
        return keys;
    }

    function getUrlParameters() {
        var getResult = parseInt("0");
        var getDivision = parseInt("0");
        var getClass = parseInt("0");
        var getCat = parseInt("0");
        individualShooter = "";
        $("#slider-" + getResult).css('visibility', 'visible');

        matchStageIndex = getResult;
        matchStageName = levels[getResult]["name"];
        divisionIndex = getDivision;
        divisionName = divisions[matchStageIndex][getDivision];
        classIndex = getClass;
        categoryIndex = getCat;
    }

    function createDropdownOptions() {
        var levelOptions = "";
        $.each(levels, function(index, key) {
            var tempStageUuid;
            if (key["stageUuid"])
                tempStageUuid = key["stageUuid"];
            else
                tempStageUuid = "d33e4dec-6ddd-4568-9466-4f3bfcaa0314";

            levelOptions += "<option value='" + index + "' index='" + index + "' stageUuid='" + tempStageUuid + "' key='" + key["name"].replace(/'/g, "%27") + "'>" + key["name"] + "</option>";
        });
        $("#resultLevel").html(levelOptions);

        divisionDropdown();

        var cls = matchDef['match_cls'].sort();
        cls = $.merge(['Classes'], cls);
        var clsOptions = "";
        $.each(cls, function(index, key) {
            clsOptions += "<option value='" + index + "' index='" + index + "' key='" + key + "'>" + key + "</option>";
        })
        $("#classLevel").html(clsOptions);
        classOptions = cls;

        var catsBase = ["Categories"];
        var ctgs;
        var match_ctgs = matchDef['match_ctgs'];
        if (match_ctgs.length > 0) {
            ctgs = $.parseJSON(match_ctgs);
            ctgs = $.merge(catsBase, ctgs);
        } else {
            ctgs = catsBase;
        }
        categoryOptions = ctgs;

        var ctgsOptions = "";
        $.each(ctgs, function(index, key) {
            ctgsOptions += "<option value='" + index + "' index='" + index + "' key='" + key + "'>" + key + "</option>";
        })
        $("#categoryLevel").html(ctgsOptions);
    }

    function divisionDropdown() {
        var divisionOptions = "";
        $.each(divisions[matchStageIndex], function(index, key) {
            divisionOptions += "<option value='" + index + "' index='" + index + "' key='" + key + "'>" + key + "</option>";
        });
        $("#divisionLevel").html(divisionOptions);
    }

    function calculateRaw() {
        for (var shooter in shootersById) {
            // for each shooter
            $.each(notDeletedStages, function(index2, stage) {
                // and each stage
                var stageItems = shootersById[shooter]["stageScores"][stage["stage_uuid"]];
                if (stageItems) {
                    $.each(stageItems, function(index3, stageItem) {
                        // each item stat per stage
                        if (Array.isArray(stageItem)) {

                            // USPSA
                            if (index3 == "ts") {
                                return true;
                            }

                            var total = 0.0;
                            $.each(stageItem, function(index4, arrayItem) {
                                total += arrayItem;
                            })

                            if (typeof (shootersById[shooter]["matchScores"][index3]) == "undefined") {
                                shootersById[shooter]["matchScores"][index3] = total;
                            } else {
                                shootersById[shooter]["matchScores"][index3] += total;
                            }
                        } else if (typeof (stageItem) == 'number') {
                            if (typeof (shootersById[shooter]["matchScores"][index3]) == "undefined") {
                                shootersById[shooter]["matchScores"][index3] = stageItem;
                            } else {
                                shootersById[shooter]["matchScores"][index3] += stageItem;
                            }
                        } else if (typeof (stageItem) == "string") {
                        } else if (typeof (stageItem) == "boolean") {
                        } else {//console.log("uncaght type: " + typeof(stageItem));
                        }
                    });
                }
            })

            switch (matchType) {
            case "uspsa_p":
                //uspsaCalculations();
                break;
            case "timeplus":
                //timePlusCalculations(shooter);
                break;
            case "idpa":
                break;
            case "timeplus_p":
                break;
            default:
                //console.log(matchType + " not supported");
            }
        }
    }

    function createResultsTable(levelIndex, level, divisionIndexInc, division) {
        var divInfo = findDivisionIndexByName(results[levelIndex][level.replace("%27", "\'")], divisionName);
        if (divInfo[0] != divisionIndex) {
            divisionIndex = divInfo[0];
            divisionName = divInfo[1];
            flashMessage("Division wasn't part of the stage. Division was changed to Overall");
        }
        var baseResults = results[levelIndex][level.replace("%27", "\'")][divInfo[0]][divInfo[1]];
        var tableString = "<table id='mainResultsTable' class='table table-striped table-condensed' cellspacing='0' width='100%'><thead><tr>";
        var titles = getSportTitles();
        $.each(titles, function(index, title) {
            tableString += "<th class='text-center'>" + title + "</th>";
        });
        tableString += "</tr></thead>";
        tableString += "<tbody>";

        var elements;
        $.each(baseResults, function(index, result) {
            elements = getSportValues(result);
            tableString += "<tr>";
            $.each(elements, function(index2, element) {
                if (index2 == 0) {
                    tableString += "<td class='text-left'>" + element + "</td>";
                } else {
                    tableString += "<td>" + element + "</td>";
                }
            })
            tableString += "</tr>";
        })
        tableString += "</tbody></table>";
        $("#mainResultsDiv").html(tableString);
        addSupporterClass();
    }

    function createIndividualTableForShooter(id) {
        var stage = $('#resultLevel').val();
        var shooter = returnShooter(id);
        var division = shooter["sh_dvp"];
        var tableString = "<table id='individualTable' class='table table-condensed' cellspacing='0' width='100%'><thead><tr>";
        var originalStage = matchStageIndex;
        matchStageIndex = 1;
        var titles = getSportTitles();
        tableString += "</th><th>Stage</th>";
        tableString += "<th><i class='fas fa-fw fa-video'></i>";

        $.each(titles, function(index, title) {
            if (title == "Name") {
                title = "#";
            }
            tableString += "<th>" + title + "</th>";
        });
        tableString += "</tr></thead>";
        tableString += "<tbody>";

        var previousMatchStageIndex = matchStageIndex;
        var previousStageUuid = stageUuid;
        var adjustedResults = {};

        if (stage != 0) {
            adjustedResults[stage] = results[stage];
        } else {
            adjustedResults = results;
        }

        for (var i in adjustedResults) {
            // exclude match
            if (i > 0) {
                matchStageIndex = i;
                var keys = getKeysFromStage(adjustedResults[i]);
                // start with overall
                var baseResults = adjustedResults[i][keys["stageName"]][0]["Overall"];
                $.each(baseResults, function(index, result) {
                    if (id == result["shooter"]) {
                        stageUuid = keys["stageId"];
                        var elements = getSportValues(result);
                        tableString += "<tr stageId='" + stageUuid + "' class='overallRow'>";

                        var stageName = keys["stageName"];
                        var maxCharaters = 20;
                        if (stageName.length > maxCharaters) {
                            stageName = stageName.substring(0, maxCharaters);
                        }
                        tableString += "<td>" + stageName + "</td>";
                        tableString += "<td class='addVideo'><button class='btn btn-xs btn-default'><i class='fas fa-fw fa-plus'></i></button></td>";

                        $.each(elements, function(index2, element) {
                            // name field trim to place field
                            if (index2 == 0) {
                                var text = $(element).text();
                                var dashIndex = text.indexOf("-");
                                var newString = text.substring(0, dashIndex);
                                element = element.replace($(element).text(), newString);
                                element = $(element).text();
                                //element = element.str.substring(0, dashIndex);
                            }
                            tableString += "<td>" + element + "</td>";
                        })
                        tableString += "</tr>";
                    }
                })
                var divisionIndex = findDivisionIndexByName(results[i][keys["stageName"]], division);
                var divisionResults = results[i][keys["stageName"]][divisionIndex[0]][division];
                $.each(divisionResults, function(index, result) {
                    if (id == result["shooter"]) {
                        stageUuid = keys["stageId"];
                        var elements = getSportValues(result);
                        tableString += "<tr stageId='" + stageUuid + "' class='divisionRow'>";

                        var stageName = keys["stageName"];
                        var maxCharaters = 16;
                        if (stageName.length > maxCharaters) {
                            stageName = stageName.substring(0, maxCharaters);
                        }
                        stageName = "<span class='stageNames'>" + stageName + "</span>";
                        tableString += "<td>" + stageName + "</td>";
                        tableString += "<td class='addVideo'><button class='btn btn-xs btn-default'><i class='fas fa-fw fa-plus'></i></button></td>";

                        $.each(elements, function(index2, element) {
                            // name field trim to place field
                            if (index2 == 0) {
                                var text = $(element).text();
                                var dashIndex = text.indexOf("-");
                                var newString = text.substring(0, dashIndex);
                                element = element.replace($(element).text(), newString);
                                element = $(element).text();
                                //element = element.str.substring(0, dashIndex);
                            }
                            tableString += "<td>" + element + "</td>";
                        })
                        tableString += "</tr>";
                    }
                })
            }
        }
        matchStageIndex = originalStage;
        stageUuid = previousStageUuid;

        tableString += "</tbody></table>";
        $("#individualResultsDiv").html(tableString);
        $(".overallRow").hide();
        $(".divisionRow").show();
        $('#radio-division').parent().addClass("active");
        $('#radio-overall').parent().removeClass("active");
    }

    function removePersonalDataFromIndividuialTable() {
        var personalData = ["Div", "Class", "Categories", "PF", "Member"];
        $.each(personalData, function(k, v) {
            var th = $('#individualTable').find('th');
            $.each(th, function() {
                if ($(this).is(':contains("' + v + '")')) {
                    var columnId = $(this).index() + 1;
                    $('#individualTable > tbody > tr > td:nth-child(' + columnId + '), #individualTable > thead > tr > th:nth-child(' + columnId + ')').remove();
                }
            })
        })
    }

    function findDivisionIndexByName(divLevel, division) {
        var foundIndex = 0;
        var foundName = "Overall";
        $.each(divLevel, function(index, value) {
            var divisionName = getFirstKey(value);
            if (division == divisionName) {
                foundIndex = index;
                foundName = divisionName;
            }
        });
        // division not found in stage
        return [foundIndex, foundName];
    }

    function flashMessage(message) {
        toastr.options = {
            "positionClass": "toast-top-full-width"
        }
        toastr.error(message);
    }

    function setDragMouseEvents(table, div) {
        var x, left, down;

        $(table).on('mousedown', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            down = true;
            x = e.pageX;
            var dtScroll = $(div).find(".dataTables_scrollBody");
            left = $(dtScroll).scrollLeft();
        });

        $(div).on('mousemove', function(e) {
            if (down) {
                var newX = e.pageX;
                var dtScroll = $(div).find(".dataTables_scrollBody");
                $(dtScroll).scrollLeft(left - newX + x);
            }
        });

        $("body").on('mouseup', function(e) {
            down = false;
        });
    }

    function setHorizontalScrollIndicator(table, div) {
        var dtScroll = $(div).find(".dataTables_scrollBody");
        $(dtScroll).on("scroll", function() {
            var s = $(dtScroll).scrollLeft()
              , d = $(table).width()
              , c = $(dtScroll).width();
            scrollPercent = (s / (d - c)) * 100;
            var position = scrollPercent;
            $(".progress-bar").css('width', position + '%').attr('aria-valuenow', position);
        });
    }

    function resetHorizontalScroll(table, div) {
        $(".progress-bar").css('width', 0 + '%').attr('aria-valuenow', 0);
        setHorizontalScrollIndicator(table, div);
    }

    function setDataTables() {
        $('#mainResultsTable').DataTable({
            "paging": false,
            "pageLength": 100,
            "ordering": false,
            "info": false,
            "fixedColumns": true,
            //                scrollY        : '50vh',
            scrollX: true,
            scrollCollapse: true,
            destroy: true,
            scroller: true,
            "initComplete": function(settings, json) {
                $(".dataTables_filter").parent().addClass("pull-left").addClass('col-xs-9').prev().addClass('col-xs-3').addClass('inlineHolder');
                $('#resultLevel option:eq(' + matchStageIndex + ')').prop('selected', true);
                $('#divisionLevel option:eq(' + divisionIndex + ')').prop('selected', true);
                $('#classLevel option:eq(' + classIndex + ')').prop('selected', true);
                $('#categoryLevel option:eq(' + categoryIndex + ')').prop('selected', true);
                filter();
                addInlineToggle();
            },
        });
    }

    function setResultChangeEvents() {
        $("#resultLevel").on("change", function() {
            var optionSelected = $("option:selected", this);
            matchStageIndex = optionSelected.attr("index");
            matchStageName = optionSelected.attr("key");
            stageUuid = optionSelected.attr("stageUuid");
            if (matchStageIndex == 0) {
                stageUuid = "";
            }
            dropdownIndex = optionSelected.attr("index");
            $(".sponsorImagesSlider").css('visibility', 'hidden');
            $("#slider-" + dropdownIndex).css('visibility', 'visible');
            divisionDropdown();
            updateUrl("#resultLevel", "q_result");
            updateTable();
            resetHorizontalScroll("#mainResultsTable", "#mainResultsDiv");
            createIndividualTableForShooter(individualShooter);
            getVideos();
            setDataTablesOnIndividual();
        });

        $("#divisionLevel").on("change", function() {
            var optionSelected = $("option:selected", this);
            divisionIndex = optionSelected.attr("index");
            divisionName = optionSelected.attr("key");
            getVideos();
            updateUrl("#divisionLevel", "q_division");
            updateTable();
            resetHorizontalScroll("#mainResultsTable", "#mainResultsDiv");
        })

        $("#classLevel").on("change", function() {
            var optionSelected = $("option:selected", this);
            classIndex = optionSelected.attr("index");

            updateUrl("#classLevel", "q_class");
            filter();
            resetHorizontalScroll("#mainResultsTable", "#mainResultsDiv");
        })

        $("#categoryLevel").on("change", function() {
            var optionSelected = $("option:selected", this);
            categoryIndex = optionSelected.attr("index");

            updateUrl("#categoryLevel", "q_category");
            filter();
            resetHorizontalScroll("#mainResultsTable", "#mainResultsDiv");
        })
        applyIndividualShooterLink();
    }

    function applyIndividualShooterLink() {
        $(".shooterLink").unbind('click');
        $(".shooterLink").on("click", function() {
            var id = $(this).attr("shooterId");
            individualShooter = id;
            updateIndividualShooterUrl(individualShooter);
            displayIndividualShooter(individualShooter);
        })
    }

    function displayIndividualShooter(id) {
        parseHistory();
        $("#individualShooterName").html(findShooterNameById(id));
        createIndividualTableForShooter(id);
        switchTables();
        setDataTablesOnIndividual();
        resetHorizontalScroll("#individualTable", "#individualResultsDiv");
        setDragMouseEvents("#individualTable", "#individualResultsDiv");
        $('html, body').scrollTop($("#resultsBaseHolder").offset().top - $('.navbar-header').height());
    }

    function switchTables() {
        getVideos();
        if ($("#mainResultsDiv").is(':visible')) {
            $("#mainResultsDiv").hide();
            $(".individual").show();
        } else {
            $(".individual").hide();
            $("#mainResultsDiv").show();
            $(".matchVideos").show();
        }
    }

    function setDataTablesOnIndividual() {
        $('#individualTable').DataTable({
            "paging": false,
            "ordering": false,
            "info": false,
            "fixedColumns": true,
            //                scrollY        : '50vh',
            scrollX: true,
            scrollCollapse: true,
            destroy: true,
            "deferRender": true,
            "initComplete": function(settings, json) {
                $(".dataTables_filter").parent().addClass("pull-left").addClass('col-xs-9').prev().addClass('col-xs-3').addClass('inlineHolder');
                addInlineToggle();
            }
        });
    }

    function updateTable() {
        parseHistory();
        createResultsTable(matchStageIndex, matchStageName, divisionIndex, divisionName);
        setDragMouseEvents("#mainResultsTable", "#mainResultsDiv");
        setDataTables();
        applyIndividualShooterLink();
    }

    function findShooterNameById(id) {
        var localShooter = returnShooter(id);
        if (matchDef['match_subtype'] === 'sass') {
            if (localShooter && localShooter["sh_al"]) {
                var name = localShooter['sh_al'] + (localShooter['sh_dq'] ? ' -DQ' : '');
                return name;
            }
        }

        if (localShooter && localShooter["sh_fn"] != null && localShooter["sh_ln"] != null) {
            var maxCharaters = 16;
            var last = localShooter["sh_ln"];
            if (localShooter["sh_ln"].length > maxCharaters)
                last = localShooter["sh_ln"].substring(0, maxCharaters);

            var first = localShooter["sh_fn"];

            var name = last + ", " + first;
            var dqFlag = "";
            if (localShooter['sh_dq'])
                dqFlag = " -DQ";
            return name + dqFlag;
        } else {
            return "Shooter Not Found";
        }
    }

    function editCountForShooter(id) {
        if (id in editCountsByShooterId) {
            if (matchStageIndex in editCountsByShooterId[id]) {
                return " <span class='left3 badge' data-toggle='tooltip' title='Number of times score was edited.'>" + editCountsByShooterId[id][matchStageIndex] + "</span>";
            }
        }

        return "";
    }

    function getShooterNameForVideo(id) {
        var localShooter = returnShooter(id);
        if (matchDef['match_subtype'] === 'sass') {
            if (localShooter && localShooter["sh_al"]) {
                var name = localShooter['sh_al'];
                return name;
            }
        }
        if (localShooter && localShooter["sh_fn"] != null && localShooter["sh_ln"] != null) {
            var maxCharaters = 16;
            var last = localShooter["sh_ln"];
            if (localShooter["sh_ln"].length > maxCharaters)
                last = localShooter["sh_ln"].substring(0, maxCharaters);

            var first = localShooter["sh_fn"];
            return first + ' ' + last;
        } else {
            return "Shooter Not Found";
        }
    }

    function checkResultValue(value) {
        if (value != null) {
            return value;
        }
        return "";
    }

    function checkResultFloatValue(value, precision) {
        precision = precision || 2;
        if (value != null) {
            if (typeof value == 'string') {
                var comma = value.lastIndexOf(',');
                var period = value.lastIndexOf('.');
                var useIndex = 0;

                // seperators not found return start value
                if (comma == -1 && period == -1) {
                    return value;
                }

                // only period found
                if (comma == -1 && period != -1) {
                    useIndex = period;
                }

                // only comma found
                if (comma != -1 && period == -1) {
                    useIndex = comma;
                }

                // comma, and period found
                if (comma != -1 && period != -1) {
                    useIndex = comma;
                    if (period > comma) {
                        useIndex = period;
                    }

                }

                return value.slice(0, useIndex + precision + 1);

            }
            value = parseFloat(value).toFixed(precision);
            return value;
        }
        return "";
    }

    function filter() {
        var classSelect = $("#classLevel");
        var categorySelect = $("#categoryLevel");
        var table = $('#mainResultsTable').DataTable();
        var classSelected = $("option:selected", classSelect);

        if (classSelected.attr("key") != "Classes") {
            table.columns(classPosition).search(classSelected.attr("key")).draw();
        } else {
            table.columns(classPosition).search("").draw();
        }

        var categorySelected = $("option:selected", categorySelect);
        if (categorySelected.attr("key") != "Categories") {
            table.columns(categoryPosition).search("\"" + categorySelected.attr("key") + "\"", false, false).draw();
        } else {
            table.columns(categoryPosition).search("").draw();
        }
    }

    function calculateFinalTime(time, bonus, pen) {
        return (time - parseFloat(bonus) + parseFloat(pen)).toFixed(2);
    }

    function bonusTitles() {
        var oneShooter = shootersById[getOneShooterId()];
        var bons = oneShooter["matchScores"]["bonsByType"];
        var bonNames = [];
        if (bons) {
            $.each(bons, function(index, value) {
                bonNames.push(hoverLinkPositive(value["name"]));
            });
            return bonNames;
        }
        return [];
    }

    function penalityTitles() {
        var oneShooter = shootersById[getOneShooterId()];
        var pens = oneShooter["matchScores"]["pensByType"];
        var penNames = [];
        if (pens) {
            $.each(pens, function(index, value) {
                penNames.push(hoverLinkNegative(value["name"]));
            });
            return penNames;
        }
        return [];
    }

    function getOneShooterId() {
        for (var prop in shootersById)
            return prop;
    }

    function hoverLinkNegative(text) {
        var maxLength = 25;
        return '<span rel="tooltip" title="' + text + '" class="text-danger">' + (text.length > maxLength ? text.substring(0, maxLength) + "..." : text) + '</span>';
    }

    function hoverLinkPositive(text) {
        var maxLength = 25;
        return '<span rel="tooltip" title="' + text + '" class="text-success">' + (text.length > maxLength ? text.substring(0, maxLength) + "..." : text) + '</span>';
    }

    function getBonusValues(id) {
        var shooter = returnShooter(id);
        var bons;
        if (stageUuid == "") {
            bons = shooter["matchScores"]["bonsByType"];
        } else {
            if (typeof shooter["stageScores"] !== 'undefined' && typeof shooter["stageScores"][stageUuid] !== 'undefined' && typeof shooter["stageScores"][stageUuid]["bonsByType"] !== 'undefined') {
                bons = shooter["stageScores"][stageUuid]["bonsByType"];
            } else {
                bons = false;
            }
        }
        var bonValues = [];
        if (bons && bons.length > 0) {
            $.each(bons, function(index, value) {
                bonValues.push(value["count"]);
            });
        }
        return bonValues;
    }

    function getPenalityValues(id) {
        var shooter = returnShooter(id);
        var pens;
        if (stageUuid == "") {
            pens = shooter["matchScores"]["pensByType"];
        } else {
            if (typeof shooter["stageScores"] !== 'undefined' && typeof shooter["stageScores"][stageUuid] !== 'undefined' && typeof shooter["stageScores"][stageUuid]["pensByType"] !== 'undefined') {
                pens = shooter["stageScores"][stageUuid]["pensByType"];
            } else {
                pens = false;
            }
        }
        var penValues = [];
        if (pens && pens.length > 0) {
            $.each(pens, function(index, value) {
                penValues.push(value["count"]);
            });
        } else {
            var matchPens = matchDef["match_penalties"];
            $.each(matchPens, function(index, value) {
                penValues.push(0);
            });
        }
        return penValues;
    }

    function calculateTargets() {
        if (matchType == "uspsa_p") {
            for (var key in shootersById) {
                var alphasTotals = 0;
                var bravosTotals = 0;
                var charliesTotals = 0;
                var deltasTotals = 0;
                var nsTotals = 0;
                var mTotals = 0;
                var npmTotals = 0;
                var stringTimeTotals = 0.0;
                var pophTotal = 0;
                var popmTotal = 0;
                var popnpmTotal = 0;
                var popnsTotal = 0;
                var procTotal = 0;
                var apenTotal = 0;

                for (var stageUuid in shootersById[key]["stageScores"]) {
                    var alphas = 0;
                    var bravos = 0;
                    var charlies = 0;
                    var deltas = 0;
                    var ns = 0;
                    var m = 0;
                    var npm = 0;
                    var stringTime = 0.0;
                    if (shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["ts"]) {
                        for (var j = 0; j < shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["ts"].length; j++) {
                            var ts = BigInt(shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["ts"][j]);
                            alphas = alphas + numAlphas(ts);
                            bravos = bravos + numBravos(ts);
                            charlies = charlies + numCharlies(ts);
                            deltas = deltas + numDeltas(ts);
                            ns = ns + numNS(ts);
                            m = m + numM(ts);
                            npm = npm + numNPM(ts);
                        }
                    }
                    for (var j = 0; j < shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["str"].length; j++) {
                        stringTime = stringTime + shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["str"][j];
                    }

                    // Add steel/pop to target scores
                    var poph = shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["poph"] ? shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["poph"] : 0;
                    var popm = shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["popm"] ? shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["popm"] : 0;
                    var popnpm = shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["popnpm"] ? shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["popnpm"] : 0;
                    var popns = shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["popns"] ? shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["popns"] : 0;
                    var proc = shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["proc"] ? shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["proc"] : 0;
                    var apen = shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["apen"] ? shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["apen"] : 0;

                    alphas += poph;
                    m += popm;
                    npm += popnpm;
                    ns += popns;

                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["numAlphas"] = alphas;
                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["numBravos"] = bravos;
                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["numCharlies"] = charlies;
                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["numDeltas"] = deltas;
                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["numNS"] = ns;
                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["numM"] = m;
                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["numProc"] = proc;
                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["numNPM"] = npm;
                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["stringTime"] = stringTime;

                    alphasTotals = alphasTotals + alphas;
                    bravosTotals = bravosTotals + bravos;
                    charliesTotals = charliesTotals + charlies;
                    deltasTotals = deltasTotals + deltas;
                    nsTotals = nsTotals + ns;
                    mTotals = mTotals + m;
                    npmTotals = npmTotals + npm;
                    stringTimeTotals = stringTimeTotals + stringTime;
                    pophTotal += poph;
                    popmTotal += popm;
                    popnpmTotal += popnpm;
                    popnsTotal += popns;
                    apenTotal += apen;
                    procTotal += proc;
                }

                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numAlphas"] = alphasTotals;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numBravos"] = bravosTotals;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numCharlies"] = charliesTotals;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numDeltas"] = deltasTotals;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numNS"] = nsTotals;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numM"] = mTotals;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numNPM"] = npmTotals;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["stringTime"] = stringTimeTotals;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numPopH"] = pophTotal;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numPopM"] = popmTotal;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numPopNpm"] = popnpmTotal;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numPopNs"] = popnsTotal;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numProc"] = procTotal;
                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["numApen"] = apenTotal;

            }
        }

        if (matchType == "idpa" || matchType == "timeplus" || matchType == "timeplus_p") {
            var bonuses = matchDef["match_bonuses"];
            var penalties = matchDef["match_penalties"];

            if (bonuses.length != 0 || penalties.length != 0) {
                for (var key in shootersById) {

                    var bonusTotal = 0;
                    var penaltyTotal = 0;
                    var stringTimeTotals = 0.0;

                    if (!shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["bonsByType"]) {
                        shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["bonsByType"] = [];
                    }
                    if (!shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["pensByType"]) {
                        shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["pensByType"] = [];
                    }

                    $.each(notDeletedStages, function(index2, stage) {
                        var stageUuid = stage["stage_uuid"];
                        var stringTime = 0.0;

                        if (!shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]) {
                            shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid] = {
                                "bons": [],
                                "pens": []
                            };
                        }

                        if (bonuses.length != 0) {
                            var bons = shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["bons"];
                            var bonCount = 0;
                            var bonTotal = 0;

                            for (var i = 0; i < bonuses.length; i++) {
                                var bon = bons && bons[i] ? bons[i] : 0;
                                bonCount = bon * bonuses[i]["bon_val"];
                                bonTotal += bonCount;
                                if (!shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["bonsByType"]) {
                                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["bonsByType"] = [];
                                }
                                shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["bonsByType"].push({
                                    "name": bonuses[i]["bon_name"],
                                    "count": bonCount
                                });
                                if (!shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["bonsByType"][i]) {
                                    shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["bonsByType"].push({
                                        "name": bonuses[i]["bon_name"],
                                        "count": 0
                                    });
                                }
                                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["bonsByType"][i]["count"] += bonCount;
                            }
                            shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["bonusTotal"] = bonCount;
                            bonusTotal += bonCount;

                        }

                        if (penalties.length != 0) {
                            var pens = shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["pens"];
                            var penCount = 0;
                            var penTotal = 0;
                            for (var i = 0; i < penalties.length; i++) {
                                var pen = pens && pens[i] ? pens[i] : 0;
                                penCount = pen * penalties[i]["pen_val"];
                                penTotal += penCount;
                                if (!shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["pensByType"]) {
                                    shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["pensByType"] = [];
                                }
                                shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["pensByType"].push({
                                    "name": penalties[i]["pen_name"],
                                    "count": penCount
                                });
                                if (!shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["pensByType"][i]) {
                                    shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["pensByType"].push({
                                        "name": penalties[i]["pen_name"],
                                        "count": 0
                                    });
                                }
                                shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["pensByType"][i]["count"] += penCount;
                            }
                            shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["penTotal"] = penCount;
                            penaltyTotal += penTotal;

                        }

                        if (shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["str"]) {
                            for (var j = 0; j < shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["str"].length; j++) {
                                stringTime = stringTime + shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["str"][j];
                            }
                        }

                        shootersById[key]["stageScores"][stageUuid]["stringTime"] = stringTime;
                        stringTimeTotals += stringTime;
                    })
                    if (bonuses.length != 0) {
                        shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["bonusTotal"] = bonusTotal;
                    }
                    if (penalties.length != 0) {
                        shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["penTotal"] = penaltyTotal;
                    }

                    stringTimeTotals = parseFloat(stringTimeTotals).toFixed(2);
                    shootersById[key]["matchScores"]["stringTime"] = stringTimeTotals;

                }
            }
        }
        ////console.log(shootersById);
    }

    // Helper function to ensure we're working with BigInt
    function toBigInt(value) {
        return typeof value === 'bigint' ? value : BigInt(value);
    }

    function numAlphas(scoreFields) {
        const score = toBigInt(scoreFields);
        const A_MASK = 0x0000000Fn;
        const A_MASK2 = 0x0000000F00000000n;
        const A_SHIFT = 0n;
        const A_SHIFT2 = 32n;

        return Number((score & A_MASK) >> A_SHIFT) + Number((score & A_MASK2) >> A_SHIFT2);
    }

    function numBravos(scoreFields) {
        const score = toBigInt(scoreFields);
        const B_MASK = 0x000000F0n;
        const B_MASK2 = 0x000000F000000000n;
        const B_SHIFT = 4n;
        const B_SHIFT2 = 36n;

        return Number((score & B_MASK) >> B_SHIFT) + Number((score & B_MASK2) >> B_SHIFT2);
    }

    function numCharlies(scoreFields) {
        const score = toBigInt(scoreFields);
        const C_MASK = 0x00000F00n;
        const C_MASK2 = 0x00000F0000000000n;
        const C_SHIFT = 8n;
        const C_SHIFT2 = 40n;

        return Number((score & C_MASK) >> C_SHIFT) + Number((score & C_MASK2) >> C_SHIFT2);
    }

    function numDeltas(scoreFields) {
        const score = toBigInt(scoreFields);
        const D_MASK = 0x0000F000n;
        const D_MASK2 = 0x0000F00000000000n;
        const D_SHIFT = 12n;
        const D_SHIFT2 = 44n;

        return Number((score & D_MASK) >> D_SHIFT) + Number((score & D_MASK2) >> D_SHIFT2);
    }

    function numNS(scoreFields) {
        const score = toBigInt(scoreFields);
        const NS_MASK = 0x000F0000n;
        const NS_MASK2 = 0x000F000000000000n;
        const NS_SHIFT = 16n;
        const NS_SHIFT2 = 48n;

        return Number((score & NS_MASK) >> NS_SHIFT) + Number((score & NS_MASK2) >> NS_SHIFT2);
    }

    function numM(scoreFields) {
        const score = toBigInt(scoreFields);
        const M_MASK = 0x00F00000n;
        const M_MASK2 = 0x00F0000000000000n;
        const M_SHIFT = 20n;
        const M_SHIFT2 = 52n;

        return Number((score & M_MASK) >> M_SHIFT) + Number((score & M_MASK2) >> M_SHIFT2);
    }

    function numNPM(scoreFields) {
        const score = toBigInt(scoreFields);
        const NPM_MASK = 0x0F000000n;
        const NPM_MASK2 = 0x0F00000000000000n;
        const NPM_SHIFT = 24n;
        const NPM_SHIFT2 = 56n;

        return Number((score & NPM_MASK) >> NPM_SHIFT) + Number((score & NPM_MASK2) >> NPM_SHIFT2);
    }

    function updateUrl(id, key) {
        var url = location.href;
        var index = $(id).val();
        var newUrl = updateQueryStringParameter(url, key, index);
        window.history.replaceState("", "Practiscore Results", newUrl);
        //history.pushState({}, 'Practiscore Results', newUrl);
        $("#fbUrl").attr("data-href", newUrl);
    }

    function updateIndividualShooterUrl(id) {
        var url = location.href;
        var newUrl = updateQueryStringParameter(url, "q_individual", id);
        window.history.replaceState("", "Practiscore Results", newUrl);
        //history.pushState({}, 'Practiscore Results', newUrl);
        $("#fbUrl").attr("data-href", newUrl);
    }

    function updateQueryStringParameter(uri, key, value) {
        var re = new RegExp("([?&])" + key + "=.*?(&|$)","i");
        var separator = uri.indexOf('?') !== -1 ? "&" : "?";
        if (uri.match(re)) {
            return uri.replace(re, '$1' + key + "=" + value + '$2');
        } else {
            return uri + separator + key + "=" + value;
        }
    }

    function returnShooter(id) {
        if (shootersById[id]) {
            return shootersById[id];
        } else if (shootersById[shootersUuidToId[id]]) {
            return shootersById[shootersUuidToId[id]];
        } else {
            return 0;
        }

    }

    function setFormData(stage) {
        if (!formDataIsSet) {
            $.each(getShooterNameList(), function(index, value) {
                $('#embedShooter').append('<option value="' + value + '">' + value[1] + '</option>');
            });
            $.each(levels, function(index, value) {
                if (index != 0) {
                    $('#embedStage').append('<option value="' + value["stageUuid"] + ',' + value["name"] + '">' + value["name"] + '</option>');
                }
            });
            $.each(divisions[0], function(index, value) {
                if (value !== 'Overall') {
                    $('#embedDivision').append('<option value="' + value + '">' + value + '</option>');
                }
            });
            formDataIsSet = true;
        }
        if (stage != 0) {
            $('#embedStage').val(levels[stage]['stageUuid'] + ',' + levels[stage]['name']);
        }
        if (individualShooter != 0) {
            $('#embedShooter').val(individualShooter + ',' + getShooterNameForVideo(individualShooter));
            $('#embedDivision').val(shootersById[individualShooter]['sh_dvp']);
        }
        generateTitle();
        generateTags();
    }

    function generateTitle() {
        var title = '';
        if ($('#embedShooter option:selected').val()) {
            title += $('#embedShooter option:selected').text() + ' | ';
        } else if ($('#embedStage option:selected').val()) {
            title += $('#embedStage option:selected').text() + ' | ';
        } else {
            title += $('#embedMatch').val() + ' | ';
        }
        $('#embedTitle').val(title + '11-14-2024')
    }

    function generateTags() {
        var tags = '\x00#' + $('#embedMatch').val().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/gi, '');
        if ($('#embedStage option:selected').text()) {
            tags += ' #' + $('#embedStage option:selected').text().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/gi, '');
        }
        if ($('#embedShooter option:selected').val()) {
            tags += ' #' + $('#embedShooter option:selected').text().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/gi, '');
        }
        if ($('#embedDivision option:selected').val()) {
            tags += ' #' + $('#embedDivision option:selected').text().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/gi, '');
        }
        var old = $('#embedDescription').val().split("\x00");
        if (old.length > 1) {
            old.pop();
            old.join(' ');
            var adjusted = old + tags;
            $('#embedDescription').val(adjusted)
        } else {
            $('#embedDescription').val(tags)
        }
    }

    $(document).on('click', '.addVideo', function() {
        if ($(this).hasClass('disabled')) {
            swal('Too many videos for this stage already exist');
        } else {
            $('#selections').addClass('in');
            var stage = $(this).closest('tr').attr('stageId');
            $('#playerContent').slideUp(600);
            $('#embedForm').trigger('reset');
            $('#addVideoDiv').slideToggle(600);
            var stageindex = 0;
            $.each(levels, function(index, values) {
                if (values['stageUuid'] === stage) {
                    stageindex = index;
                    return false;
                }
            });
            if ($('#embedForm').length > 0) {
                setFormData(stageindex);
            }
            $('html, body').animate({
                scrollTop: $('#addVideoDiv').offset().top - $('.navbar-header').height()
            }, 500);
        }
    });

    $(document).on('keyup', '#embedVideo', function() {

        var id = getYouTubeId($('#embedVideo').val());
        if (id !== 'error') {
            $('#embedVideo').val('https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + id);
        }

        var url = $('#embedVideo').val();
        if (isUrlValid(url)) {
            var acceptedList = ['youtube'];
            var accepted = false;
            $.each(acceptedList, function(index, value) {
                if (url.indexOf(value) !== -1) {
                    return accepted = true;
                }
            });
            if (accepted) {
                $('#videoPreview').show();
                $('#invalidPreview').hide();
                $('#iframePreview').hide();
                $('#videoPreview').find('iframe').attr('src', url);
                $('#accept_terms').closest('.hidden').removeClass('hidden').attr('id', 'acceptDiv');
                $('#acceptDiv').show();
                $('#embedSubmit').show();
            } else {
                $('#invalidPreview').html('Only videos posted to ' + acceptedList.join(' or ') + ' currently accepted.').show();
                $('#videoPreview').hide();
                $('#iframePreview').hide();
                $('#embedSubmit').hide();
                $('#acceptDiv').hide();
            }
        } else {
            $('#invalidPreview').html('Must be a valid url.').show();
            $('#videoPreview').hide();
            $('#iframePreview').hide();
            $('#embedSubmit').hide();
            $('#acceptDiv').hide();
        }
    });

    });

    function isUrlValid(url) {
        var valid = /^(https?|s?ftp):\/\/(((([a-z]|\d|-|\.|_|~|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])|(%[\da-f]{2})|[!\$&'\(\)\*\+,;=]|:)*@)?(((\d|[1-9]\d|1\d\d|2[0-4]\d|25[0-5])\.(\d|[1-9]\d|1\d\d|2[0-4]\d|25[0-5])\.(\d|[1-9]\d|1\d\d|2[0-4]\d|25[0-5])\.(\d|[1-9]\d|1\d\d|2[0-4]\d|25[0-5]))|((([a-z]|\d|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])|(([a-z]|\d|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])([a-z]|\d|-|\.|_|~|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])*([a-z]|\d|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])))\.)+(([a-z]|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])|(([a-z]|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])([a-z]|\d|-|\.|_|~|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])*([a-z]|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])))\.?)(:\d*)?)(\/((([a-z]|\d|-|\.|_|~|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])|(%[\da-f]{2})|[!\$&'\(\)\*\+,;=]|:|@)+(\/(([a-z]|\d|-|\.|_|~|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])|(%[\da-f]{2})|[!\$&'\(\)\*\+,;=]|:|@)*)*)?)?(\?((([a-z]|\d|-|\.|_|~|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])|(%[\da-f]{2})|[!\$&'\(\)\*\+,;=]|:|@)|[\uE000-\uF8FF]|\/|\?)*)?(#((([a-z]|\d|-|\.|_|~|[\u00A0-\uD7FF\uF900-\uFDCF\uFDF0-\uFFEF])|(%[\da-f]{2})|[!\$&'\(\)\*\+,;=]|:|@)|\/|\?)*)?$/i.test(url);
        if (valid) {
            var youtube = (url.indexOf('youtube.com') !== -1);
            return youtube;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function getYouTubeId(url) {
        var regExp = /^.*(youtu.be\/|v\/|u\/\w\/|embed\/|watch\?v=|\&v=)([^#\&\?]*).*/;
        var match = url.match(regExp);
        if (match && match[2].length === 11) {
            return match[2];
        }
        return 'error';
    }

    function getVideos() {
        var match = 'd33e4dec-6ddd-4568-9466-4f3bfcaa0314';
        var shooter = individualShooter;
        var stage = levels[matchStageIndex]['stageUuid'];
        var division = divisionName ? divisionName : null;
        var newVideoSelection = match + shooter + stage + division + inlineVideos;
        //            if (videoSelection === newVideoSelection) {
        //                return;
        //            }
        $.ajax({
            url: 'https://practiscore.com/getvideos',
            type: 'GET',
            data: {
                match: match,
                shooter: shooter,
                stage: stage,
                division: division
            },
            success: function(data) {
                videoSelection = newVideoSelection;
                videoCount = data[1];
                addInlineToggle();
                if ($('#playerContent').is(':hidden')) {
                    $('#playVideoButton').html('<i class="fas fa-fw fa-video"></i>&nbsp; Show Videos (' + data[1] + ')');
                }
                if (data[1] == 0) {
                    $('#playVideoButton').hide();
                    $('#playerContent').slideUp(600);
                } else {
                    if (!stage) {
                        $('#playerContent').html(data[0]);
                        $('.pagination').css('margin', '0px');
                        if ($('#playerContent').is(':hidden') && playerDisplay) {
                            $('#playVideoButton').trigger("click");
                        }
                        $('#playVideoButton').show();
                        if (shooter !== "0" && shooter !== 0 && shooter !== "") {
                            addMediaRows(data[3])
                        } else {
                            $('#toggleInlineVideo').hide();
                        }
                    } else {
                        $('#playVideoButton').hide();
                        $('#playerContent').slideUp(600);
                        addMediaRows(data[3]);
                    }
                    hideUpload(data[4]);

                    $('.iframeVideo').contents().width(200).height(150);

                }
                markShootersWithMedia(data[2]);
                $('.videosLightbox a').fancybox({
                    caption: function(instance, item) {
                        return $(this).attr('data-title');
                    }
                });
                $('#mainResultsTable').DataTable().columns.adjust();
            }
        });
    }

    $(function() {
