    });

    function getShooterNameList() {
        var nameList = [];
        for (var shooter in shootersById) {
            nameList.push([shooter, getShooterNameForVideo(shooter)]);
        }
        nameList.sort(function(a, b) {
            return a[1].localeCompare(b[1]);
        });
        return nameList;
    }

    function addSupporterClass() {
        $('a[class="shooterLink"]').each(function() {
            var id = $(this).attr('shooterid');
            var supporter = id in supporterList;
            if (supporter !== false) {
                if ($(this).parent().find($('.supporter')).length == 0) {
                    $(this).html($(this).html() + '<a href="/support"  style="display: inline-block"><img class="supporter badge-inline" src="' + supporterList[id] + '"></a>');
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function markShootersWithMedia(mediaList) {
        $('a[class="shooterLink"]').each(function() {
            if ($.inArray($(this).attr('shooterid'), mediaList) != -1) {
                $(this).wrap("<div class='top_border'></div>").before("<div class='pull-left left_triangle'></div>");
                //                    $(this).parent().css({'width':'0','height':'0','border-style':'solid','border-width':'10px 10px 0 0','border-color':'#007bff transparent transparent transparent'});
                $(this).addClass('hasMedia');
            }
        });
        addSupporterClass();
        $('#mainResultsTable').DataTable().columns.adjust();
    }

    function addMediaRows(views) {
        $('.videoRow').remove();
        $('#toggleInlineVideo').show();

        if (!inlineVideos) {
            return false;
        }
        var colCount = 10;
        if (individualShooter == 0) {
            colCount = $('#mainResultsTable tr:nth-child(1)').children('td').length;
            $.each(views, function(shooter_id, view) {
                var shooterLink = $('#mainResultsTable').find('[shooterId="' + shooter_id + '"]');
                if (shooterLink.length > 0) {
                    shooterLink.closest('tr').after('<tr class="videoRow" id="videoCard' + shooter_id + '" >' + '<td id="cardHolder" colspan=' + colCount + '><div class="col-xs-12 videoInlineHolder videosHolder bottom20">' + view + '</div></td></tr>');
                    var index = shooterLink.closest('tr').index();
                    var height = $('#videoCard' + shooter_id).height();
                    var nameTable = $('[data-dt-row="' + index + '"]').closest('table');
                    nameTable.find('[shooterId="' + shooter_id + '"]').closest('tr').after('<tr style="height:' + height + 'px;" class="' + shooter_id + ' videoRow" id="videoRow" ><td></td></tr>');
                }
            });
        } else {
            var displayType = $('[name="displayRadioOptions"].active').val();
            colCount = $('#individualTable tr:nth-child(1)').children('td').length;
            if (!colCount) {
                colCount = $('#individualTable tr:nth-child(2)').children('td').length;
            }
            $.each(views, function(stage_id, view) {
                var stageLink = $('#individualTable').find('[stageId="' + stage_id + '"].' + displayType + 'Row');
                if (stageLink.length > 0) {
                    stageLink.after('<tr class=" videoRow" id="videoCard' + stage_id + '" >' + '<td id="cardHolder" colspan=' + colCount + '><div class="col-xs-12 videoInlineHolder videosHolder bottom20">' + view + '</div></td></tr>');
                    var index = stageLink.closest('tr').index();
                    var height = $('#videoCard' + stage_id).height();
                    var nameTable = $('[data-dt-row="' + index + '"]').closest('table');
                    nameTable.find('[stageId="' + stage_id + '"].' + displayType + 'Row').closest('tr').after('<tr style="height:' + height + 'px;" class="' + stage_id + ' videoRow" id="videoRow" ><td></td></tr>');
                }
            });
            $('#individualTable').DataTable().columns.adjust();
        }

    }

    function hideUpload(stages) {
        $.each(stages, function(index, stage) {
            $('[stageId="' + stage + '"]').find('.addVideo').addClass('disabled').find('i').addClass('disabled');
        });
    }

    function addInlineToggle() {
        if (videoCount > 0) {
            var button = '<a href="" rel="tooltip" title="toggle result videos" id="toggleInlineVideo" ';
            button += 'class="left20 top20 pull-left">';
            button += '<i class="fas ' + (inlineVideos ? 'fa-video-slash' : 'fa-video') + ' "></i><span class="hidden-xs">' + (inlineVideos ? ' Hide Videos' : ' Show Videos') + '</span></a>';

            $('.inlineHolder').html(button);
        }

    }

    function downloadURI(uri, name) {
        let link = document.createElement("a");
        link.download = name;
        link.href = uri;
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);
        // delete link;
    }

        let url = window.createIdpaExt(matchJsonString, scoresJsonString);
        downloadURI(url, 'IDPA.csv');
    })

    $(document).on('click', '#toggleInlineVideo', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        $(this).find('svg').toggleClass('fa-video fa-video-slash');
        inlineVideos = !inlineVideos;

<script>
    /*jslint unparam: true, regexp: true */
    /*global window, $ */
    $(function() {
        'use strict';
        // Change this to the location of your server-side upload handler:
        var url = 'https://practiscore.com/videos'
          , uploadButton = $('<button/>')//                    .text('Finalize Upload')
        .addClass('pull-right btn btn-success').prop('disabled', true).text('Processing...').on('click', function() {
            $("#embedForm").validate({
                errorPlacement: function(error, element) {
                    $(element).closest('.form-group').addClass('has-error');
                    error.appendTo($(element).closest('.form-group').find('.help-block > .error'));
                }
            });
            if (!$('#embedForm').valid()) {
                var error = $('<span class="text-danger"/>').text('Please fix errors and try again.');
                $(this).parent().append('<br>').append(error);
                return false;
            }
            $('#embedForm').submit(function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
            });
            $('#embedVideo').removeAttr('required');
            if ($('#accept_terms').is(':checked')) {
                $('#embedShooter').removeAttr('disabled');
                $('#embedMatch').removeAttr('disabled');
                $('#embedStage').removeAttr('disabled');
                $('#embedDivision').removeAttr('disabled');
                $('#uploadSpinner').show();
                var $this = $(this)
                  , data = $this.data();
                $this.off('click').text('Abort').removeClass('btn-success').addClass('btn-danger').on('click', function() {
                    $this.remove();
                    $('#uploadSpinner').hide();
                    data.abort();
                });
                data.submit().always(function() {
                    $this.remove();
                });
            }
        });
        $('#fileupload').fileupload({
            url: url,
            dataType: 'json',
            autoUpload: false,
            acceptFileTypes: /(\.|\/)(mp4|MP4|mov|MOV)$/i,
            maxFileSize: 250 * 1000000,
            // convert to MBs
            maxChunkSize: 2 * 1000000,
            // Enable image resizing, except for Android and Opera,
            // which actually support image resizing, but fail to
            // send Blob objects via XHR requests:
            disableImageResize: /Android(?!.*Chrome)|Opera/.test(window.navigator.userAgent),
            previewMaxWidth: '100px',
            previewMaxHeight: '100px',
            previewCrop: true,
        }).on('fileuploadadd', function(e, data) {
            data.context = $('<div/>').appendTo('#video');
            $.each(data.files, function(index, file) {
                var node = $('<p/>').append($('<span/>').text(file.name));
                if (!index) {
                    node.append('<br>').append(uploadButton.clone(true).data(data));
                }
                node.appendTo(data.context);
            });
        }).on('fileuploadprocessalways', function(e, data) {
            var index = data.index
              , file = data.files[index]
              , node = $(data.context.children()[index]);
            if (file.preview) {
                node.prepend('<br>').prepend(file.preview).prepend('Preview<br>');
            }
            if (file.error) {
                node.append('<br>').append($('<span class="text-danger"/>').text(file.error));
            }
            if (index + 1 === data.files.length) {
                data.context.find('button').text('Finalize Upload').prop('disabled', !!data.files.error);

            }
        }).on('fileuploadprogressall', function(e, data) {
            var progress = parseInt(data.loaded / data.total * 100, 10);
            $('#progress .progress-bar').css('width', progress + '%');
        }).on('fileuploaddone', function(e, data) {
            $.each(data.result.files, function(index, file) {
                if (file.url) {
                    var link = $('<a>').attr('target', '_blank').prop('href', file.url);
                    $(data.context.children()[index]).wrap(link);
                } else if (file.error) {
                    var error = $('<span class="text-danger"/>').text(file.error);
                    $(data.context.children()[index]).append('<br>').append(error);
                }
            });
        }).on('fileuploadfail', function(e, data) {
            bugsnagClient.notify(data.errorThrown);

            $.each(data.files, function(index) {
                var error = $('<span class="text-danger"/>').text('File upload failed. Please make sure you are on a decent connection. Videos are usually large files.');
                $(data.context.children()[index]).append('<br>').append(error);
            });
        }).on('fileuploaddone', function(e, data) {
            $.each(data.files, function(index) {
                var success = $('<span class="text-success"/>').text('Video successfully uploaded.');
                $(data.context.children()).append('<br>').append(success);
            });
            location.reload();
        }).prop('disabled', !$.support.fileInput).parent().addClass($.support.fileInput ? undefined : 'disabled');
    });

<script>
    $(document).ready(function() {
        $('.resultStyle').click(function() {
            var resultStyle = $(this).attr('result-type');
            $.post('/session/result-style/' + resultStyle, function(data) {
                var redirect = '';
                if (resultStyle === 'whatif') {
                    if (location.href.includes('/cards/')) {
                        redirect = location.href.replace('/cards/', '/whatif/')
                    } else {
                        redirect = location.href.replace('/new/', '/whatif/')
                    }
                } else {
                    if (resultStyle === 'card') {
                        redirect = location.href.replace('/new/', '/cards/');
                    } else {
                        redirect = location.href.replace('/cards/', '/new/');
                    }
                }

                window.location = redirect;
            });
        });
    });
</script>
